releaseNotes:
v5.2.0 — Equalizer Redesign, Bluetooth EQ, Ringtone Setter, Library UX:

Equalizer:
• Completely redesigned equalizer UI to match the app's Material3 design language
• Horizontal scrolling preset chips with color-coded genre/system/custom sections
• Per-band color-coded gain labels (green=boost, red=cut, monospace dB)
• Animated spectrum visualizer with pulsing bars
• Effects panel with percentage readouts and reverb dropdown

Bluetooth:
• Added Bluetooth/Wired/USB audio device detection via AudioManager
• Connected device shown as badge next to equalizer title
• Per-device EQ profiles — earbuds remember their own preset automatically
• Added BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission with runtime request

Ringtone:
• Added 'Set as Ringtone' option to the player's three-dot menu
• Uses StreamResolver for reliable audio resolution instead of broken NewPipe extractor
• Player auto-pauses and sheet collapses when ringtone trimmer opens

Player Options:
• Added video resolution selector (Auto/1080p/720p/480p/360p/240p/144p) with persistent choice
• Three-dot sheet now opens fully expanded (skipPartiallyExpanded)

Library:
• Added search bar to filter playlists/albums/artists by title
• Added filter chips (All/Playlists/Albums/Artists) to narrow sections
• Added A-Z/Z-A sort toggle

Search:
• Songs played from search results now saved to recent searches with thumbnail
• Fixed suggestions list scrolling behind the search box
• Scroll state resets to top when suggestions change

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed player options sheet not expanding to show all options
• Fixed build-breaking stray characters in MusicPlaybackService
• Fixed recent searches not persisting song results
• Fixed video quality preference not being persisted
• Fixed ringtone audio stream resolution failure
